# Appearance QA brands

Tembo's icon and semantic colours come from the user-owned `temboai.com` app. The light PNG is its published 192 px icon. The dark PNG is a raster export of the same SVG using the SVG's existing dark-mode fills (#1A0F05 and #E8A84C). Palette values use Tembo's Baobab and Tembo tokens, choosing the readable secondary text and focus variants.

Northstar is a synthetic violet brand for isolation and contrast QA. These fixtures configure only the isolated Sounding test datastore; they never update live Tembo or Slipway configuration.
